selectionProtocol.static: Per market-side choice trained only on the 365 calendar days before the 180-day test. Requires >=180 comparable calls, >=3 net hits, non-negative first/second halves and recent 120.
selectionProtocol.rolling: At each prediction, choose from the prior 240 route events only; require >=180 comparable events, >=3 net hits and non-negative two most recent 80-event segments.
selectionProtocol.sameWindowRankings: Descriptive only. They are not valid model-selection evidence.
